records.text: Dominick Dunne reported that money for the killing traced back to the DuPont family and that it appeared Lisa Dean and Christopher Moseley had the victim killed.
records.speaker: Dominick Dunne

appearances.snippet: And as Dominick Dunne reported in Vanity Fair, the money traced back to the DuPont family. It appeared that Lisa Dean—who is a DuPont—didn't approve of her drug-addicted son dating a drug-addicted Vegas sex worker. So she and her husband, Christopher Moseley, had her killed.

verification.notes: Contemporary court reporting confirms that Christopher Moseley, husband of DuPont heiress Lisa Dean Moseley, contracted for Patricia Margello’s murder and pleaded guilty. It does not establish Candace’s stronger assertion that Lisa jointly had Margello killed. The canonical name is Moseley, correcting the transcript/legacy Mosley error. Legacy verification history remains in provenance.
